data.one_liner: Connects mobile devices to Wi-Fi networks using a specific SSID or SSID prefix.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that enables simple programmatic connection to Wi-Fi devices using an exact SSID or an SSID prefix. It works on Android 10+ and iOS 11+, making it suitable for interacting with IoT hardware.
use_when: You need to connect your Flutter app directly to an IoT device via Wi-Fi.
You want to connect to a Wi-Fi network using an exact SSID or an SSID prefix with a password.
avoid_when: You need advanced Wi-Fi scanning features beyond simple prefix matching and connecting.
Target platforms do not meet the minimum OS requirements (Android 10+, iOS 11+).
strengths: Supports both exact SSID and SSID prefix matching.
Low dependency plugin focused strictly on Wi-Fi connectivity.
Compatible with modern Android and iOS versions.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific permissions like ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION on Android.
Certain networks like captive portals or MDM-managed networks may not work on iOS.
data.setup_notes: Add required Android permissions (ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE, CHANGE_WIFI_STATE) to AndroidManifest.xml.
